F1: The handler calls `new CalendarCacheRepository()` directly instead of `CalendarCache.init()`, so the `calendar-cache` flag is skipped and the new mock method is never used; with the flag off, leftover cache rows still show a cache status and a delete option.
F2: Access is still correctly denied; the only issue is the error code (500 instead of 403/404), and the client shows the same generic error toast either way.
F3: Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", …)` always shows the date in US format, even when the label around it is translated, so non-English users see the wrong date format.
F4: An empty fixed-width column is a small layout issue, not a functional defect.
F5: This is a local helper script that prints the path it writes to; the cwd-relative path is a minor tooling annoyance.
F6: This is an interactive local helper script that no CI runs, so the exit code on failure has little real effect.
